shortDescription: Solana's decentralized exchange trading volume exceeded $1.96 billion over the past 24 hours, according to DefiLlama data. According to ChainCatcher, this put Solana ahead of BNB Chain at $1.64 billion and Robinhood Chain at $1.61 billion, returning it to the top spot.

title: Solana DEX Volume Tops $1.96 Billion in 24 Hours, Reclaims First Place
